romantic_affection.text: The singer references past deep involvement, meeting family, and adopting a dog together.
romantic_affection.label: mention

heartbreak.text: The narrator acknowledges that despite trying everything, they failed at being a traditional romantic couple.
heartbreak.label: depiction

romance.text: Past serious courtship and domestic life are recalled as background to their current status.
romance.label: mention

desire.text: The lyrics highlight that their physical intimacy and hookups are remarkable and irresistible.
desire.label: depiction

sexual_suggestion.text: The singer states he enters her bedroom when they miss each other, implying sexual encounters without romantic commitment.
sexual_suggestion.label: depiction

casual_sex.text: The arrangement is defined as an individual affair where they hook up casually while keeping separate lives.
casual_sex.label: endorsement

reciprocity.text: Both parties are framed as understanding and sharing the mutual boundary of hooking up without emotional entanglement.
reciprocity.label: depiction

inferred_consent.text: Visiting each other's rooms when longing strikes indicates an agreed-upon casual dynamic.
inferred_consent.label: depiction
